title: Notice on New Trading Pairs & Trading Bots Services on Binance Spot - 2024-02-28
text: Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Spot and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance will open trading for the CKB/TRY, COTI/TRY, LDO/TRY and UNI/USDC spot trading pairs at  2024-02-28 08:00 (UTC) . In addition, Binance will enable Trading Bots services for the following trading pairs at  2024-02-28 08:00 (UTC) .  Spot Grid, Spot DCA & Rebalancing Bot: PIXEL/USDT, STRK/USDT Spot Algo Orders: CKB/TRY, COTI/TRY, LDO/TRY and UNI/USDC Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes: TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-02-27
